regions.today: Widespread rain this evening with blustery southeast winds.
regions.tonight: Wet and breezy early tonight. However, mainly dry conditions with clear spells will develop overnight. Lowest temperatures by dawn of zero to +3 degrees, with the moderate to fresh southeast winds becoming westerly and easing as the rain clears, with some frost and icy patches possible by morning.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Friday, will be a dry, bright day with plenty of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 8 to 10 degrees in light winds.
